notes:
• Apps that open another app's window, like Gemini (which opens in the Google app), no longer keep the loading screen up for 12 seconds. It closes as soon as the window appears.
• These apps now get window buttons (close, minimize, maximize) too.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
